summary: Update a device's OS by changing the target image in its spec; the agent downloads and verifies the new bootc image (an OCI reference such as quay.io/flightctl-example/rhel:9.5) in the background, installs it at the time set by the update policy without disrupting the running OS, reboots into it and reports progress in the device status.
questions: How do I update the OS on an Edge Manager device?
When does the Edge Manager agent apply an OS update?
What image reference format does Edge Manager support?
How do I track an OS update on a device?
